scope_repairs.rule: A scope repair changes the evidence span, so unlike the metadata upgrades it is not a metadata-only overlay. The builder still writes only to v2: the v1 record keeps its original span, hash and approval, and both are carried on the v2 record so the promotion is auditable in one place.
